summary.zh-TW: 收件匣、待辦清單常見的手勢：往左滑一點露出刪除按鈕並停住；滑超過一半放開就直接刪除，整列滑出去後高度收起來，下面的項目往上補。一次只會打開一列，鍵盤可以按 Delete 刪除。
summary.en: A common inbox and to-do gesture: swipe a little to reveal and hold the delete button; swipe past halfway and let go to delete — the row slides out, collapses, and the rows below move up. Only one row opens at a time, and the Delete key works too.

text.zh-TW: 只能往左拖，最多拖一整列寬；往右拖不動。刪除按鈕一直都在項目下面，項目往左移就露出來。
text.en: Drag only leftward, at most one row width. The delete button always sits underneath; moving the row left reveals it.

text.zh-TW: 放開時依照拖了多遠決定三種結果：超過一半寬就刪除、超過按鈕寬的一半就停在打開的位置、其他就彈回去。拖過「刪除線」時圖示先放大，讓使用者在放開前就知道會發生什麼。
text.en: On release the distance picks one of three outcomes: past half the row deletes, past half the button stays open, otherwise it springs back. The icon grows when you cross the delete line so you know before letting go.

text.zh-TW: 刪除分兩段：先整列滑出畫面，再把高度收成 0。如果直接 remove()，下面的項目會「瞬間跳上來」，看不出少了哪一列。
text.en: Deleting has two steps: slide the row out, then collapse its height to 0. Removing it outright makes the rows below jump up, hiding which one disappeared.

text.zh-TW: 滑動是滑鼠和觸控的捷徑，不是唯一的方法：每列都能用鍵盤選到並按 Delete 刪除，刪除按鈕本身也能用 Tab 選到。
text.en: Swiping is a shortcut, not the only way: every row can be focused and deleted with the Delete key, and the delete button is reachable with Tab.
